title: 1981-04-16_Pat_54.txt
concise_summary: PKD synthesizes entropy physics, Platonic metaphysics, and Christian theology to argue that Christ and VALIS function as cosmic negentropy—reversing disorder through information injection. He proposes that his 2-3-74 experience involved a reversal of Heidegger's Fall (the shift from being-Logos to having-Logos at Aristotle), achieved through right-brain meta-abstraction that renders time illusory and reveals Plato's Forms as the true structure of reality. Crucially, he reconceptualizes Thomas (from the Ditheon dream) as a spirit summoned through symbolic reperformance rather than reincarnation.
key_claims: Christ is equivalent to negentropy: he represents newness, life, growth, and the antagonist of mechanical/ossified systems, signaled by effects exceeding their causes
The Holy Spirit breaks ossified states in individuals and societies by injecting crucial amounts and kinds of new information into 'stuck' organisms
Time is not real; only change and change-rate velocity exist—sacramental reperformance works by aligning consciousness with the slower change-rate of mythic events

Platonic Form theory (combined with hologram physics) explains how a single eidos can be perceived at multiple places and times, unifying the physical universe as an intelligible complex of ideas in God's mind
Anamnesis is not memory of a previous life but meta-abstracted comprehension of atemporal reality after the category of time is rendered irreal
The Ditheon dream corroborates that combining two human psyches yields Christ—a term for successful psychic unity, possibly explaining Jesus's man/God nature
